strengths_district2011.nonfarm_expected.description: Value that the fit on Urban share, Population density (log) predicts.

strengths_district2011.graduates_score.description: Graduates: residual of a least-squares fit on Urban share, Population density (log), Households with a two-wheeler, Households with electric light, in standard deviations (n = 640, R² = 0.68). Positive = better than places with the same conditions.

strengths_district2011.graduates_expecte.name: Graduates: expected
strengths_district2011.graduates_expecte.description: Value that the fit on Urban share, Population density (log), Households with a two-wheeler, Households with electric light predicts.

strengths_district2011.female_literacy_s.name: Female literacy beyond wealth (score)
strengths_district2011.female_literacy_s.description: Female literacy (7+): residual of a least-squares fit on Urban share, Households with a two-wheeler, Households with electric light, in standard deviations (n = 640, R² = 0.42). Positive = better than places with the same conditions.

strengths_district2011.female_literacy_e.name: Female literacy (7+): expected
